El-Dorado · Atlantis — 3D deposit model

A 3D viewer of the Atlantis Au‑Cu(‑Mo) porphyry (El-Dorado / Atlantis porphyry district). This model ingests a kriged block model — the ordinary‑kriged block model and the interpreted mineralised‑envelope & barren‑nucleus wireframes — and is registered against the desurveyed drill holes.
